Save where otherwise appears, the facts deposed hereto are within my personal knowledge or are derived from office files and records and sources to which I have access and are true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief.

3. I understand that the FSD will produce to the Committee a List of Documents (“LoD”), a draft of which I have read, indexing all relevant documents in the FSD’s possession.
